name: notion-blog-post-to-hero-image

trigger.trigger_note: Catch hook. The Blog database's 'Generate Image' button property POSTs the page here (payload shape { data: <page object> }). `webhook_url` is the one Notion calls; `trigger_url` is Zapier-internal. Cutover done 2026-08-14: the button is repointed at this URL and the classic 'Generate Blog Post Image' Zap is off (confirmed by Dennis, not machine-verifiable).

notion.note: The page cover is set as a NOTION-HOSTED file (download bytes -> file_uploads single_part -> PATCH cover), per Dennis's request — the classic Zap's custom action ae:345724 stored an external URL that rots when the Gemini link expires. The Cover Image File property is filled by the Notion upload_file_to_data_source_item action (its own hosted upload; a file_upload id can only be attached once, so the cover's upload cannot be reused). No create_database_item call in this Zap, so repo rule 5's template helper does not apply.

gemini.note: Nano Banana Pro. Image models are only offered under v1beta; the classic Zap's manual-prompt path said v1alpha and worked by accident. No aspect-ratio param exists — sizing rides in the prompt text (AI-brief path appends 'The image should be 1536x1024'; a hand-written Prompt (Optional) is passed verbatim).

ai_model.why: Single creative-writing task: turn post markdown into one image-generation prompt. The classic Zap used the raw Anthropic app (Claude Opus 4.5, user's own billing) with a brand-guidelines PDF knowledge source; AI by Zapier has no knowledge sources, so the brand guidance is embedded in the prompt instead. Verified 2026-08-14 that standard/auto produces an on-brand, hex-correct, style-tagged brief on a real post — see the README's verified-cases table.

replaces_classic_zap: Generate Blog Post Image (exported 2026-08-14; webhook -> paths on Prompt (Optional) -> Anthropic/AI brief -> Gemini -> ae:345724 external cover + upload_file_to_data_source_item)
